outcomes.outcome: rsyslog and its GnuTLS driver are installed, and rsyslog runs and starts at boot

with no ssldir_override, the node's Puppet CA, certificate and key are copied for rsyslog from the agent's own ssldir (an AIO agent's /etc/puppetlabs/puppet/ssl, local change #23), byte for byte, and form a valid identity
with ssldir_override, the copies come from the directory given
on an agent without the aio_agent_version fact (the pre-AIO packages), the copies come from /var/lib/puppet/ssl

uncovered.why: every lab agent is an AIO agent, and so is the production agent read on the laptop (puppet-agent 5.5.22); no lab node kind runs the pre-AIO packages
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: an agent without the aio_agent_version fact (the pre-AIO puppet packages)
uncovered.evidence: facter aio_agent_version gives 8.24.2 on puppet8node and on p8lab-rhel9 (2026-11-24), each with puppet config print ssldir /etc/puppetlabs/puppet/ssl; .codex_state/lab/nodes.yml lists no pre-AIO agent; CLAUDE.md records the laptop's agent as puppet-agent 5.5.22

outcomes.outcome: the user rsyslog drops to (syslog) can read the key, and other users cannot
a stopped rsyslog runs again after the next agent run
a change to the TLS directory restarts rsyslog at the next agent run
a change to a TLS file (a renewed certificate) restarts rsyslog once at the next agent run
on RedHat, a syslog user and group (uid/gid 0) exist for the copied files' ownership
